value.rationale: Length-resolved first/second moments are a natural low-dimensional compression of the complete substring composition measurement; determining exactly when this loses distinguishability is an intrinsic reconstruction-information question. The sharp first failure at 11, complete four-word splitting configurations, and one shortest-window cubic statistic repairing all n<=11 establish an interpretable, reproducible structural boundary, not an arbitrary finite table. Limitations: ideal readout, binary alphabet, finite cutoff.
